title: Manual activation reference tabs
requirements: Build four horizontal tabs labelled Overview, Unavailable, Details and History in a tablist named Reference sections. Unavailable is disabled. Start with Overview selected and its associated panel visible. Left/Right skip disabled tabs and explicitly wrap around enabled tabs. Home/End move to the first/last enabled tab. Navigation changes focus only; Enter, Space or pointer activation changes selection. Keep one roving tab stop, one selected tab, one visible panel, and reciprocal accessible relationships. Repeated selections must not duplicate controls or panels. Include a Remove reference fixture button followed by an After fixture button; removing the fixture leaves keyboard navigation to the latter available. This fixture explicitly opts into looping; it does not assert a Proto default.
